title: Text Watermarking for Non-Academics
excerpt: How statistical text watermarks encode machine-readable signals in ordinary prose, how detectors recover them, and how copying, editing, and rewriting affect the result.
content_html:
Anthropic has just announced how Claude marks AI-generated content, bringing text watermarking into immediate practical discussion. A watermark in plain text is less intuitive than one in an image or a file because copied text appears to leave its provenance behind. These two articles examine the mechanism and its implications. This first article explains how statistical text watermarking works from first principles, the second examines what detecting such a watermark would allow us to conclude.

How Do You Watermark Plain Text?

Images provide an obvious place for a watermark: a system can alter pixel values by amounts too small for a person to notice, while a detector can still recover the resulting pattern. Digital files can also carry metadata that records their origin or editing history. Plain text appears to offer neither option because it consists only of characters on a page.

Copy a paragraph from a document into Notepad and save it as a new file. The operation discards most of the surrounding information, including document metadata and details of the original formatting. What remains is the sequence of words and punctuation that the reader can see. Any marker that depends on the original file has disappeared.

The text still contains more information than its literal meaning, however. A writer repeatedly chooses between words such as but and however, contractions such as don't and do not, and several ways of arranging the same thought. Sentence length, punctuation, vocabulary, and grammatical construction introduce further choices. Each version can communicate substantially the same idea while leaving a different sequence of characters behind. Natural language as an encoding system is inherently redundant, and that redundancy allows a writer to leave a statistical signal in the text itself.

A language model makes comparable choices whenever it generates text. Given the passage produced so far, the model assigns probabilities to possible next tokens and selects one according to its generation settings. A token can be a whole word, part of a word, a punctuation mark, or another text fragment. The visible sentence is therefore the result of many selections from many possible continuations.

A simple completion illustrates the available freedom. The list below contains several plausible continuations for the same opening:

The result was ...

unexpected
surprising
interesting
quite different
hard to explain
...

Several completions can be fluent and appropriate. Selecting one of them changes the text without requiring hidden characters or attached metadata. The chosen words themselves preserve the selection after someone copies the passage into another document.

Text watermarking uses this freedom in a controlled way. During generation, a watermarking system can influence which acceptable continuation the model selects. Across a long passage, those influenced choices form a statistical pattern that a detector can test for later. The pattern lives in how the text was chosen, so it remains part of the text after ordinary copying and pasting.

An individual choice reveals almost nothing. A person can write however, and an unmodified language model can select it as well. Evidence starts accumulating when many small choices lean in a coordinated direction more often than chance would predict. This dependence on accumulated evidence is why statistical text watermarking belongs to a different category from a visible label or a fixed hidden message.

Anthropic's announcement gives the subject new practical relevance, but the general technique is broader than Claude or any other product. Vendors can use different token-selection rules and detection methods, and public descriptions do not provide a complete implementation specification. The principles in this article describe the technology rather than attributing a particular design to Anthropic.

Humans Already Have Statistical Fingerprints

Of course the choices encoded in a piece of text existed long before language models. Every writer develops habits through education, reading, geography, profession, and personal preference. Some habits are easy to notice, while others appear only after someone counts them across a substantial body of work. Apparently, a text without any pattern would be very difficult to read. Two writers expressing similar ideas can consistently favour different forms. Their tendencies might look like this:

Writer A                  Writer B

but                       however
for example               for instance
don't                     do not
shorter sentences         longer sentences
few semicolons            frequent semicolons
simple punctuation        lots of em dashes (the classical LLM watermark)

Finding however in a document provides no useful attribution on its own. Writers use words outside their usual habits, and the subject of a document strongly affects its vocabulary. A contract and a message to a friend will differ even when the same person wrote both. Individual observations become informative only when they form a consistent pattern.

The study of such patterns is called stylometry. It measures features of writing and uses them to compare texts or estimate authorship. Useful features include the frequency of common function words, preferences in spelling and punctuation, sentence-length distributions, and recurring grammatical constructions. Many of these features attract little conscious attention from the writer, which can make them more stable than conspicuous turns of phrase.

Stylometric analysis works by comparing measurements rather than searching for a unique signature embedded in every document. Given several texts known to come from a writer, an analyst can estimate how often that writer makes particular linguistic choices. The same measurements taken from an unknown text can then be compared with the known samples. A closer match raises the evidence for common authorship, while a weaker match lowers it.

Sample length controls how much evidence is available. Ten words contain few choices and can easily resemble the habits of many writers by chance. Ten thousand words provide repeated observations of vocabulary, punctuation, syntax, and sentence structure. Accidental variation begins to average out, allowing persistent tendencies to become clearer.

More text, however, does not remove every source of uncertainty. Topic affects vocabulary, genre changes formality, editing can replace an author's usual constructions, and people alter their style over time. Reliable analysis has to account for these influences and compare like with like. A collection of informal emails offers a poor baseline for attributing a technical manual, even when both sets of text involve the same candidate author.

Authorship attribution therefore produces a statistical conclusion. An analysis can show that one candidate's writing is more consistent with the observed text than another candidate's, or that a match would be unusual under a stated alternative. The result depends on the available samples, the measured features, the comparison population, and the assumptions in the method. It does not provide the certainty of reading an author's name from an intact document record.

Statistical identification of writing did not begin with AI. Human writing already demonstrated that repeated linguistic choices can act as evidence about a text's source. Language models create text through a different process, but they also make repeated choices with measurable tendencies. That connection allows the same statistical intuition to carry into machine-generated text.

Language Models Have Fingerprints Too

A language model generates text by repeatedly estimating what token should come next. The estimate takes the form of a probability distribution over the tokens in its vocabulary. After the phrase The result was, a simplified view of that distribution might look like this:

unexpected     18%
surprising     15%
interesting    11%
quite           8%
not             6%
encouraging     4%
...             ...

These numbers are illustrative, but the structure reflects the real process. The model assigns different probabilities to possible continuations, then a decoding procedure uses those probabilities to choose a token. That token becomes part of the context for the next calculation, and the process continues until the response is complete.

Different models assign different probabilities in the same context. One model might favour unexpected, while another gives more weight to surprising. The difference can be too small to notice in a single response, yet it influences which words and constructions appear across a larger collection of outputs. Taken together, those tendencies form a natural model fingerprint.

The fingerprint comes from the entire system that produces the text. Several parts of that system shape the observed pattern:

  • Training data and model architecture shape the underlying probability distribution.
  • Post-training changes which kinds of responses the model favours.
  • System prompts and product-level instructions influence the model before it generates a response.
  • Decoding and sampling settings, including temperature (a control that makes token choices more predictable at lower values and more varied at higher values), determine how the system selects from the available tokens.

Even when the underlying model remains fixed, changes to its system prompt or sampling settings can alter the pattern in its output. A fingerprint therefore characterizes the complete generation setup rather than the model alone. This means versions of the same model can leave different fingerprints. A provider can update training, adjust post-training, revise its system prompts, or change how the product samples tokens. An attribution method built around the old behaviour can lose accuracy after such a change. A fingerprint describes a particular generation process under particular conditions rather than a permanent identity attached to a brand name.

So model fingerprinting is essentially stylometry taken one step further. Human stylometry infers likely authorship from linguistic patterns that arise through a person's ordinary writing habits. The writer does not need to place a signature in the text or follow a secret procedure. The evidence comes from tendencies already present in the writing. Model fingerprinting applies the same broad idea to text generated from a model's ordinary probability distributions. It looks for patterns associated with a likely generation setup. The model does not need to cooperate with the detector, and the generation process does not need to encode a deliberate signal.

And finally, we have arrived at the final idea: what if we deliberately influence the model's choices to create a stronger, more detectable signal? That is the essence of text watermarking:

By guiding the model's token selection in a controlled way, we can embed a statistical pattern that a detector can later identify.

From a technical perspective, I'm finding the idea fascinating: there is nothing new about the underlying statistical principles, but the whole process of altering a model's output to leave a detectable signal in plain text is pure evil genius. Let's see how it works in practice.

Tiny Differences Become Evidence

Creating a statistical pattern does not make every affected token identifiable. A model choosing however instead of but proves nothing because both people and models can choose either word regardless of whether a watermark is present. The useful evidence lies in the balance of choices across the text rather than in any particular word.

Suppose a detectable pattern makes one group of otherwise reasonable tokens slightly more likely to be selected. A short sentence might contain only a few places where that preference can affect the output. Its final token sequence can easily match the pattern by chance, or miss the pattern even when the generation process applied it. A confident conclusion would demand more evidence than the sentence contains.

A 50,000-word document, on the other hand, presents a radically different measurement problem. It contains many opportunities for the generation process to express the same small preference. Some choices will lean away from the expected pattern, as random variation guarantees, while the aggregate can still show a persistent imbalance. The detector becomes less concerned with any single selection and more concerned with whether the observed total is plausible under ordinary generation.

The intuition resembles repeated measurement. One noisy observation leaves many explanations open, while a large collection can reveal a small effect that remains invisible at the individual level. Statistical tests turn that accumulated difference into a score by comparing the observed pattern with an expected baseline. The strength of the result depends on both the size of the measured effect and the amount of usable text.

Token choices are not independent observations. Each selected token becomes context for the next selection, so neighbouring choices influence one another. Topic and prompting change which vocabulary is available, while editing can remove or replace parts of the original pattern. Distribution shift creates another problem when the analysed text comes from different conditions than the text used to design or calibrate the detector.

Engineering the Fingerprint

A watermarking system creates a stronger pattern by changing the probabilities the model already calculated. Consider a moment when the model has several reasonable ways to describe a server under load. Its original distribution could look like this:

Normal distribution

slow          27%
overloaded    23%
struggling    19%
saturated     17%
unhappy       14%

The watermarking rule marks some of the available tokens as preferred for this particular position. It then moves a small amount of probability towards those tokens before the sampling process makes its choice:

Watermarked distribution

slow          24%
overloaded    26%  <- preferred
struggling    17%
saturated     20%  <- preferred
unhappy       13%

The model remains free to select any of the candidates. Preferred tokens simply become a little more likely, allowing fluency and variation to remain. A reader has no reason to find overloaded or saturated suspicious because both fit the context perfectly well.

The shift becomes visible only in aggregate, as the previous section explained. Preferred choices appear more often than the original distribution predicts, and a detector measures that excess. A statistical text watermark is an engineered fingerprint: the generation process deliberately strengthens a pattern that ordinary text would exhibit only by chance.

Where the Secret Pattern Comes From

A fixed list of preferred words would be easy to discover and remove. Practical proposals instead derive the preference from a secret key and the local context. A deterministic calculation uses the key to process the preceding tokens, with some designs also incorporating the current position, and divides suitable next tokens into preferred and ordinary sets.

The calculation is pseudorandom, which means its results look random to someone without the key while remaining exactly reproducible for someone who has it. The generator and detector can therefore agree on which tokens were preferred at every position without storing a copy of each decision. An observer who sees only the finished text cannot reconstruct the pattern from a simple vocabulary list.

The same word can play a different role each time it appears. However might belong to the preferred set after one sequence of tokens and to the ordinary set after another. Descriptions claiming that a model will use a collection of special watermark words miss this context dependence. The signal comes from the relationship between each token and the context in which the model selected it.

Keeping the key private also protects the scheme. Someone who learns the selection rule can deliberately avoid preferred tokens to weaken the signal or favour them to imitate it. The security of the mechanism therefore depends partly on controlling access to the information needed to reconstruct the pattern.

This is why the idea has a very high ceiling: the patterns can be arbitrarily complex, and a detector that knows the key can reconstruct the same sets and test for the expected imbalance. Over time, we can expect to see more sophisticated watermarking schemes that are harder to remove and easier to detect, while still leaving the text fluent and natural. Applying the same increasingly complex, evolved patterns to fingerprinting and stylometry has huge potential too.

Detecting and Damaging the Signal

Detection repeats the keyed calculation against the finished text. Given the text and the information defining the watermark, the detector works through four operations:

  1. Reconstruct the preferred token set at each usable position.
  2. Record how often the text selected a preferred token.
  3. Compare that count with the result expected from ordinary text.
  4. Calculate how surprising the observed excess would be by chance.

The output is a statistical score rather than a hidden field reading AI_GENERATED=true. A detection service chooses a threshold above which it reports the watermark as present. Raising that threshold reduces false positives but misses more genuinely watermarked text, while lowering it catches weaker signals at the cost of more false alarms.

Ordinary corrections often leave enough original choices for detection, especially in a long passage. Extensive rewriting replaces a larger share of the evidence, and a fresh paraphrase can produce a new token sequence with little connection to the original pattern. A watermark's robustness is its ability to remain detectable after the text has been edited. It can be measured by how the detector's confidence falls as more of the original choices are replaced.

Things get tricky when someone edits specifically to defeat detection. A strong watermark should tolerate ordinary transformations while avoiding unnatural language or a rigid generation process. Making the pattern harder to remove generally requires influencing more choices or applying a stronger bias, which increases the chance that the intervention affects the output itself.

Does the Watermark Affect the Output?

Watermarking changes the generation distribution, but a changed distribution does not establish a loss of quality. A slightly less probable token can remain correct, fluent, clear, and appropriate for the context. If the highest-probability choice were always the best one, selecting the top token at every step would consistently produce the best possible response, which it does not.

The amount of safe room depends on the uncertainty at a particular position. Some contexts leave almost no reasonable choice:

The capital of France is ...

Paris    99.9%

Moving substantial probability towards another token would risk a factual error. A watermarking system gains little useful capacity from such a position and should leave the dominant choice alone. Other contexts offer several continuations with similar probabilities:

The result is ...

interesting   21%
surprising    20%
notable       18%
unexpected    17%

Here the system has more room to favour one reasonable option without making the sentence worse. Watermarking methods can concentrate their influence on these higher-uncertainty positions and reduce it where the model strongly prefers one answer. The design balances signal strength, resistance to editing, fidelity to the original distribution, and output quality.

Quality also depends on the task being measured. A change that leaves ordinary prose fluent can still alter a precise factual answer or a program. Evaluations therefore need to test the properties relevant to the output rather than treating probability shifts as a complete measure of quality.

Code makes the constraint particularly visible: a prose sentence often has many acceptable formulations, while a line of code must satisfy syntax and preserve behaviour. Identifiers, formatting, comments, and alternative implementations provide some freedom, but each choice can also affect readability or correctness.

return err

A short statement such as this contains little harmless room for encoding a statistical preference. Larger programs contain more choices, although many are constrained by language rules and the surrounding codebase. The available capacity depends on the kind of content, and no conclusion about how a commercial system treats code follows from the general mechanism alone.

What the Detector Finds

A successful detector provides evidence that the examined text contains the statistical pattern the watermark was designed to create. The strength of that evidence depends on the scheme, the detector's calibration, the available text, and any transformations applied after generation. Note that the detector doesn't prove that the text was generated by LLMs, or that it was generated by a particular model, or that it was generated by a model at all. It only shows that the text contains the expected statistical pattern. Also cannot determine how much of the text was generated by a model, or how much was edited, or rewritten. The detector can only report on the presence of the watermark pattern in the text.

Conclusion

Plain text has no separate layer in which a durable marker can hide, yet the choices that compose the text provide another channel. A watermarking system uses a secret rule to favour certain acceptable tokens in particular contexts. Those small interventions accumulate into a pattern that copying preserves, editing weakens, and a detector can measure against chance. The mechanism gives a provenance system a measurable signal. A complete history of the text remains outside its reach. Detection cannot reveal who requested the output or who later revised it, and the final document can contain material assembled through several different processes. The statistical result describes the text presented to the detector under the assumptions built into that detector.

The difficult questions begin when people turn that result into a claim about authorship or conduct. Technical confidence becomes one piece of evidence inside a larger judgement about where the text came from and how it was used. The second article examines what a detected watermark actually proves, which conclusions go beyond the evidence, and what happens when institutions treat a statistical signal as a verdict.

The amount of safe room depends on the uncertainty at a particular position. Some contexts leave almost no reasonable choice: The capital of France is ... Paris 99.9% Moving substantial probability towards another token would risk a factual error. A watermarking system gains little useful capacity from such a position and should leave the dominant choice alone. Other contexts offer several continuations with similar probabilities: The result is ... interesting 21% surprising 20% notable 18% unexpected 17% Here the system has more room to favour one reasonable option without making the sentence worse. Watermarking methods can concentrate their influence on these higher-uncertainty positions and reduce it where the model strongly prefers one answer. The design balances signal strength, resistance to editing, fidelity to the original distribution, and output quality. Quality also depends on the task being measured. A change that leaves ordinary prose fluent can still alter a precise factual answer or a program. Evaluations therefore need to test the properties relevant to the output rather than treating probability shifts as a complete measure of quality. Code makes the constraint particularly visible: a prose sentence often has many acceptable formulations, while a line of code must satisfy syntax and preserve behaviour. Identifiers, formatting, comments, and alternative implementations provide some freedom, but each choice can also affect readability or correctness. return err A short statement such as this contains little harmless room for encoding a statistical preference. Larger programs contain more choices, although many are constrained by language rules and the surrounding codebase. The available capacity depends on the kind of content, and no conclusion about how a commercial system treats code follows from the general mechanism alone. What the Detector Finds A successful detector provides evidence that the examined text contains the statistical pattern the watermark was designed to create. The strength of that evidence depends on the scheme, the detector's calibration, the available text, and any transformations applied after generation. Note that the detector doesn't prove that the text was generated by LLMs, or that it was generated by a particular model, or that it was generated by a model at all. It only shows that the text contains the expected statistical pattern. Also cannot determine how much of the text was generated by a model, or how much was edited, or rewritten. The detector can only report on the presence of the watermark pattern in the text. Conclusion Plain text has no separate layer in which a durable marker can hide, yet the choices that compose the text provide another channel. A watermarking system uses a secret rule to favour certain acceptable tokens in particular contexts. Those small interventions accumulate into a pattern that copying preserves, editing weakens, and a detector can measure against chance. The mechanism gives a provenance system a measurable signal. A complete history of the text remains outside its reach. Detection cannot reveal who requested the output or who later revised it, and the final document can contain material assembled through several different processes. The statistical result describes the text presented to the detector under the assumptions built into that detector. The difficult questions begin when people turn that result into a claim about authorship or conduct. Technical confidence becomes one piece of evidence inside a larger judgement about where the text came from and how it was used. The second article examines what a detected watermark actually proves, which conclusions go beyond the evidence, and what happens when institutions treat a statistical signal as a verdict.

blocks.html_en: Anthropic has just announced how Claude marks AI-generated content, bringing text watermarking into immediate practical discussion. A watermark in plain text is less intuitive than one in an image or a file because copied text appears to leave its provenance behind. These two articles examine the mechanism and its implications. This first article explains how statistical text watermarking works from first principles, the second examines what detecting such a watermark would allow us to conclude.

sentences.en: Anthropic has just announced how Claude marks AI-generated content, bringing text watermarking into immediate practical discussion.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 刚刚宣布了 Claude 如何标记人工智能生成的内容，将文本水印带入了立即的实际讨论。

sentences.en: A watermark in plain text is less intuitive than one in an image or a file because copied text appears to leave its provenance behind.
sentences.zh: 纯文本中的水印不如图像或文件中的水印直观，因为复制的文本似乎会留下其出处。

sentences.en: These two articles examine the mechanism and its implications.
sentences.zh: 这两篇文章探讨了这一机制及其影响。

sentences.en: This first article explains how statistical text watermarking works from first principles, the second examines what detecting such a watermark would allow us to conclude.
sentences.zh: 第一篇文章从基本原理解释了统计文本水印的工作原理，第二篇文章研究了检测此类水印将使我们得出什么结论。

blocks.html_en: How Do You Watermark Plain Text?

sentences.en: How Do You Watermark Plain Text?
sentences.zh: 如何为纯文本添加水印？

blocks.html_en: Images provide an obvious place for a watermark: a system can alter pixel values by amounts too small for a person to notice, while a detector can still recover the resulting pattern. Digital files can also carry metadata that records their origin or editing history. Plain text appears to offer neither option because it consists only of characters on a page.

sentences.en: Images provide an obvious place for a watermark: a system can alter pixel values by amounts too small for a person to notice, while a detector can still recover the resulting pattern.
sentences.zh: 图像为水印提供了一个明显的位置：系统可以以小到人们无法注意到的程度改变像素值，而检测器仍然可以恢复生成的图案。

sentences.en: Digital files can also carry metadata that records their origin or editing history.
sentences.zh: 数字文件还可以携带记录其来源或编辑历史的元数据。

sentences.en: Plain text appears to offer neither option because it consists only of characters on a page.
sentences.zh: 纯文本似乎不提供这两个选项，因为它仅由页面上的字符组成。

blocks.html_en: Copy a paragraph from a document into Notepad and save it as a new file. The operation discards most of the surrounding information, including document metadata and details of the original formatting. What remains is the sequence of words and punctuation that the reader can see. Any marker that depends on the original file has disappeared.

sentences.en: Copy a paragraph from a document into Notepad and save it as a new file.
sentences.zh: 将文档中的段落复制到记事本中并将其另存为新文件。

sentences.en: The operation discards most of the surrounding information, including document metadata and details of the original formatting.
sentences.zh: 该操作会丢弃大部分周围信息，包括文档元数据和原始格式的详细信息。

sentences.en: What remains is the sequence of words and punctuation that the reader can see.
sentences.zh: 剩下的是读者可以看到的单词和标点符号的顺序。

sentences.en: Any marker that depends on the original file has disappeared.
sentences.zh: 任何依赖于原始文件的标记都已消失。

blocks.html_en: The text still contains more information than its literal meaning, however. A writer repeatedly chooses between words such as but and however, contractions such as don't and do not, and several ways of arranging the same thought. Sentence length, punctuation, vocabulary, and grammatical construction introduce further choices. Each version can communicate substantially the same idea while leaving a different sequence of characters behind. Natural language as an encoding system is inherently redundant, and that redundancy allows a writer to leave a statistical signal in the text itself.

sentences.en: The text still contains more information than its literal meaning, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，该文本仍然包含比其字面含义更多的信息。

sentences.en: A writer repeatedly chooses between words such as but and however, contractions such as don't and do not, and several ways of arranging the same thought.
sentences.zh: 作者反复在“但是”和“然而”等词、“不”和“不”等缩写词以及排列同一思想的几种方式之间进行选择。

sentences.en: Sentence length, punctuation, vocabulary, and grammatical construction introduce further choices.
sentences.zh: 句子长度、标点符号、词汇和语法结构引入了进一步的选择。

sentences.en: Each version can communicate substantially the same idea while leaving a different sequence of characters behind.
sentences.zh: 每个版本都可以传达基本相同的想法，同时留下不同的字符序列。

sentences.en: Natural language as an encoding system is inherently redundant, and that redundancy allows a writer to leave a statistical signal in the text itself.
sentences.zh: 自然语言作为一种编码系统本质上是冗余的，这种冗余允许作者在文本本身中留下统计信号。

blocks.html_en: A language model makes comparable choices whenever it generates text. Given the passage produced so far, the model assigns probabilities to possible next tokens and selects one according to its generation settings. A token can be a whole word, part of a word, a punctuation mark, or another text fragment. The visible sentence is therefore the result of many selections from many possible continuations.

sentences.en: A language model makes comparable choices whenever it generates text.
sentences.zh: 语言模型每当生成文本时都会做出类似的选择。

sentences.en: Given the passage produced so far, the model assigns probabilities to possible next tokens and selects one according to its generation settings.
sentences.zh: 给定到目前为止生成的段落，模型将概率分配给可能的下一个标记，并根据其生成设置选择一个。

sentences.en: A token can be a whole word, part of a word, a punctuation mark, or another text fragment.
sentences.zh: 标记可以是整个单词、单词的一部分、标点符号或另一个文本片段。

sentences.en: The visible sentence is therefore the result of many selections from many possible continuations.
sentences.zh: 因此，可见的句子是从许多可能的延续中进行许多选择的结果。

blocks.html_en: A simple completion illustrates the available freedom. The list below contains several plausible continuations for the same opening:

sentences.en: A simple completion illustrates the available freedom.
sentences.zh: 一个简单的完成说明了可用的自由。

sentences.en: The list below contains several plausible continuations for the same opening:
sentences.zh: 下面的列表包含同一开口的几个看似合理的延续：

blocks.html_en: Several completions can be fluent and appropriate. Selecting one of them changes the text without requiring hidden characters or attached metadata. The chosen words themselves preserve the selection after someone copies the passage into another document.

sentences.en: Several completions can be fluent and appropriate.
sentences.zh: 多次完成可以流畅、恰当。

sentences.en: Selecting one of them changes the text without requiring hidden characters or attached metadata.
sentences.zh: 选择其中之一即可更改文本，而无需隐藏字符或附加元数据。

sentences.en: The chosen words themselves preserve the selection after someone copies the passage into another document.
sentences.zh: 当有人将段落复制到另一个文档中时，所选单词本身会保留选择。

blocks.html_en: Text watermarking uses this freedom in a controlled way. During generation, a watermarking system can influence which acceptable continuation the model selects. Across a long passage, those influenced choices form a statistical pattern that a detector can test for later. The pattern lives in how the text was chosen, so it remains part of the text after ordinary copying and pasting.

sentences.en: Text watermarking uses this freedom in a controlled way.
sentences.zh: 文本水印以受控方式利用这种自由。

sentences.en: During generation, a watermarking system can influence which acceptable continuation the model selects.
sentences.zh: 在生成过程中，水印系统可以影响模型选择哪个可接受的延续。

sentences.en: Across a long passage, those influenced choices form a statistical pattern that a detector can test for later.
sentences.zh: 在很长的一段时间内，那些受到影响的选择形成了一种统计模式，检测器可以稍后对其进行测试。

sentences.en: The pattern lives in how the text was chosen, so it remains part of the text after ordinary copying and pasting.
sentences.zh: 该模式存在于文本的选择方式中，因此在普通复制和粘贴后它仍然是文本的一部分。

blocks.html_en: An individual choice reveals almost nothing. A person can write however, and an unmodified language model can select it as well. Evidence starts accumulating when many small choices lean in a coordinated direction more often than chance would predict. This dependence on accumulated evidence is why statistical text watermarking belongs to a different category from a visible label or a fixed hidden message.

sentences.en: An individual choice reveals almost nothing.
sentences.zh: 个人的选择几乎没有透露任何东西。

sentences.en: A person can write however, and an unmodified language model can select it as well.
sentences.zh: 然而，一个人可以写作，并且未经修改的语言模型也可以选择它。

sentences.en: Evidence starts accumulating when many small choices lean in a coordinated direction more often than chance would predict.
sentences.zh: 当许多小选择比偶然预测的更频繁地倾向于协调的方向时，证据就开始积累。

sentences.en: This dependence on accumulated evidence is why statistical text watermarking belongs to a different category from a visible label or a fixed hidden message.
sentences.zh: 这种对积累证据的依赖是统计文本水印与可见标签或固定隐藏消息属于不同类别的原因。

blocks.html_en: Anthropic's announcement gives the subject new practical relevance, but the general technique is broader than Claude or any other product. Vendors can use different token-selection rules and detection methods, and public descriptions do not provide a complete implementation specification. The principles in this article describe the technology rather than attributing a particular design to Anthropic.

sentences.en: Anthropic's announcement gives the subject new practical relevance, but the general technique is broader than Claude or any other product.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 的声明为该主题提供了新的实际意义，但总体技术比 Claude 或任何其他产品更广泛。

sentences.en: Vendors can use different token-selection rules and detection methods, and public descriptions do not provide a complete implementation specification.
sentences.zh: 供应商可以使用不同的代币选择规则和检测方法，并且公开描述没有提供完整的实现规范。

sentences.en: The principles in this article describe the technology rather than attributing a particular design to Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 本文中的原理描述了该技术，而不是将特定设计归因于 Anthropic。

blocks.html_en: Humans Already Have Statistical Fingerprints

sentences.en: Humans Already Have Statistical Fingerprints
sentences.zh: 人类已经有了统计指纹

blocks.html_en: Of course the choices encoded in a piece of text existed long before language models. Every writer develops habits through education, reading, geography, profession, and personal preference. Some habits are easy to notice, while others appear only after someone counts them across a substantial body of work. Apparently, a text without any pattern would be very difficult to read. Two writers expressing similar ideas can consistently favour different forms. Their tendencies might look like this:

sentences.en: Of course the choices encoded in a piece of text existed long before language models.
sentences.zh: 当然，一段文本中编码的选择早在语言模型之前就已经存在了。

sentences.en: Every writer develops habits through education, reading, geography, profession, and personal preference.
sentences.zh: 每个作家都会通过教育、阅读、地理、职业和个人喜好来养成习惯。

sentences.en: Some habits are easy to notice, while others appear only after someone counts them across a substantial body of work.
sentences.zh: 有些习惯很容易注意到，而另一些习惯则只有在有人在大量工作中进行统计后才会出现。

sentences.en: Apparently, a text without any pattern would be very difficult to read.
sentences.zh: 显然，没有任何模式的文本将很难阅读。

sentences.en: Two writers expressing similar ideas can consistently favour different forms.
sentences.zh: 表达相似想法的两位作家可能会一致偏爱不同的形式。

sentences.en: Their tendencies might look like this:
sentences.zh: 他们的倾向可能是这样的：

blocks.html_en: Finding however in a document provides no useful attribution on its own. Writers use words outside their usual habits, and the subject of a document strongly affects its vocabulary. A contract and a message to a friend will differ even when the same person wrote both. Individual observations become informative only when they form a consistent pattern.

sentences.en: Finding however in a document provides no useful attribution on its own.
sentences.zh: 然而，在文档中查找本身并不能提供有用的归属。

sentences.en: Writers use words outside their usual habits, and the subject of a document strongly affects its vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 作者使用的词语超出了他们的惯常习惯，文档的主题强烈影响其词汇。

sentences.en: A contract and a message to a friend will differ even when the same person wrote both.
sentences.zh: 即使是同一个人写的合同和给朋友的信息也会有所不同。

sentences.en: Individual observations become informative only when they form a consistent pattern.
sentences.zh: 只有当个体观察形成一致的模式时，它们才能够提供信息。

blocks.html_en: The study of such patterns is called stylometry. It measures features of writing and uses them to compare texts or estimate authorship. Useful features include the frequency of common function words, preferences in spelling and punctuation, sentence-length distributions, and recurring grammatical constructions. Many of these features attract little conscious attention from the writer, which can make them more stable than conspicuous turns of phrase.

sentences.en: The study of such patterns is called stylometry.
sentences.zh: 对这种模式的研究称为文体测量学。

sentences.en: It measures features of writing and uses them to compare texts or estimate authorship.
sentences.zh: 它衡量写作的特征，并用它们来比较文本或估计作者身份。

sentences.en: Useful features include the frequency of common function words, preferences in spelling and punctuation, sentence-length distributions, and recurring grammatical constructions.
sentences.zh: 有用的特征包括常用功能词的频率、拼写和标点符号的偏好、句子长度分布以及重复出现的语法结构。

sentences.en: Many of these features attract little conscious attention from the writer, which can make them more stable than conspicuous turns of phrase.
sentences.zh: 其中许多特征很少引起作者的有意识的注意，这可以使它们比引人注目的措辞更稳定。

blocks.html_en: Stylometric analysis works by comparing measurements rather than searching for a unique signature embedded in every document. Given several texts known to come from a writer, an analyst can estimate how often that writer makes particular linguistic choices. The same measurements taken from an unknown text can then be compared with the known samples. A closer match raises the evidence for common authorship, while a weaker match lowers it.

sentences.en: Stylometric analysis works by comparing measurements rather than searching for a unique signature embedded in every document.
sentences.zh: 文体测量分析的工作原理是比较测量结果，而不是搜索每个文档中嵌入的独特签名。

sentences.en: Given several texts known to come from a writer, an analyst can estimate how often that writer makes particular linguistic choices.
sentences.zh: 鉴于已知来自某位作家的几篇文本，分析人员可以估计该作家做出特定语言选择的频率。

sentences.en: The same measurements taken from an unknown text can then be compared with the known samples.
sentences.zh: 然后可以将从未知文本中获取的相同测量值与已知样本进行比较。

sentences.en: A closer match raises the evidence for common authorship, while a weaker match lowers it.
sentences.zh: 更接近的匹配会提高共同作者身份的证据，而较弱的匹配则会降低这一证据。

blocks.html_en: Sample length controls how much evidence is available. Ten words contain few choices and can easily resemble the habits of many writers by chance. Ten thousand words provide repeated observations of vocabulary, punctuation, syntax, and sentence structure. Accidental variation begins to average out, allowing persistent tendencies to become clearer.

sentences.en: Sample length controls how much evidence is available.
sentences.zh: 样本长度控制可用证据的数量。

sentences.en: Ten words contain few choices and can easily resemble the habits of many writers by chance.
sentences.zh: 十个词的选择很少，很容易偶然地与许多作家的习惯相似。

sentences.en: Ten thousand words provide repeated observations of vocabulary, punctuation, syntax, and sentence structure.
sentences.zh: 一万个单词提供了对词汇、标点符号、语法和句子结构的重复观察。

sentences.en: Accidental variation begins to average out, allowing persistent tendencies to become clearer.
sentences.zh: 偶然的变化开始趋于平均，使持续的趋势变得更加清晰。

blocks.html_en: More text, however, does not remove every source of uncertainty. Topic affects vocabulary, genre changes formality, editing can replace an author's usual constructions, and people alter their style over time. Reliable analysis has to account for these influences and compare like with like. A collection of informal emails offers a poor baseline for attributing a technical manual, even when both sets of text involve the same candidate author.

sentences.en: More text, however, does not remove every source of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 然而，更多的文字并不能消除所有不确定性来源。

sentences.en: Topic affects vocabulary, genre changes formality, editing can replace an author's usual constructions, and people alter their style over time.
sentences.zh: 主题影响词汇，体裁改变形式，编辑可以取代作者通常的结构，人们随着时间的推移改变他们的风格。

sentences.en: Reliable analysis has to account for these influences and compare like with like.
sentences.zh: 可靠的分析必须考虑这些影响并进行同类比较。

sentences.en: A collection of informal emails offers a poor baseline for attributing a technical manual, even when both sets of text involve the same candidate author.
sentences.zh: 非正式电子邮件的集合为技术手册的归属提供了较差的基线，即使两组文本都涉及同一候选作者。

blocks.html_en: Authorship attribution therefore produces a statistical conclusion. An analysis can show that one candidate's writing is more consistent with the observed text than another candidate's, or that a match would be unusual under a stated alternative. The result depends on the available samples, the measured features, the comparison population, and the assumptions in the method. It does not provide the certainty of reading an author's name from an intact document record.

sentences.en: Authorship attribution therefore produces a statistical conclusion.
sentences.zh: 因此，作者归属会产生统计结论。

sentences.en: An analysis can show that one candidate's writing is more consistent with the observed text than another candidate's, or that a match would be unusual under a stated alternative.
sentences.zh: 分析可以表明，一位候选人的写作比另一位候选人的写作与观察到的文本更加一致，或者在规定的替代方案下，匹配将是不寻常的。

sentences.en: The result depends on the available samples, the measured features, the comparison population, and the assumptions in the method.
sentences.zh: 结果取决于可用样本、测量特征、比较总体以及方法中的假设。

sentences.en: It does not provide the certainty of reading an author's name from an intact document record.
sentences.zh: 它不能确保从完整的文档记录中读取作者姓名。

blocks.html_en: Statistical identification of writing did not begin with AI. Human writing already demonstrated that repeated linguistic choices can act as evidence about a text's source. Language models create text through a different process, but they also make repeated choices with measurable tendencies. That connection allows the same statistical intuition to carry into machine-generated text.

sentences.en: Statistical identification of writing did not begin with AI.
sentences.zh: 写作的统计识别并不是从人工智能开始的。

sentences.en: Human writing already demonstrated that repeated linguistic choices can act as evidence about a text's source.
sentences.zh: 人类书写已经证明，重复的语言选择可以作为文本来源的证据。

sentences.en: Language models create text through a different process, but they also make repeated choices with measurable tendencies.
sentences.zh: 语言模型通过不同的过程创建文本，但它们也会做出具有可测量倾向的重复选择。

sentences.en: That connection allows the same statistical intuition to carry into machine-generated text.
sentences.zh: 这种联系允许将相同的统计直觉带入机器生成的文本中。

blocks.html_en: Language Models Have Fingerprints Too

sentences.en: Language Models Have Fingerprints Too
sentences.zh: 语言模型也有指纹

blocks.html_en: A language model generates text by repeatedly estimating what token should come next. The estimate takes the form of a probability distribution over the tokens in its vocabulary. After the phrase The result was, a simplified view of that distribution might look like this:

sentences.en: A language model generates text by repeatedly estimating what token should come next.
sentences.zh: 语言模型通过重复估计接下来应该出现的标记来生成文本。

sentences.en: The estimate takes the form of a probability distribution over the tokens in its vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 估计采用词汇表中标记的概率分布的形式。

sentences.en: After the phrase The result was, a simplified view of that distribution might look like this:
sentences.zh: 在短语“结果是”之后，该分布的简化视图可能如下所示：

blocks.html_en: These numbers are illustrative, but the structure reflects the real process. The model assigns different probabilities to possible continuations, then a decoding procedure uses those probabilities to choose a token. That token becomes part of the context for the next calculation, and the process continues until the response is complete.

sentences.en: These numbers are illustrative, but the structure reflects the real process.
sentences.zh: 这些数字是说明性的，但结构反映了真实的过程。

sentences.en: The model assigns different probabilities to possible continuations, then a decoding procedure uses those probabilities to choose a token.
sentences.zh: 该模型为可能的连续分配不同的概率，然后解码过程使用这些概率来选择标记。

sentences.en: That token becomes part of the context for the next calculation, and the process continues until the response is complete.
sentences.zh: 该令牌成为下一次计算上下文的一部分，并且该过程将继续，直到响应完成。

blocks.html_en: Different models assign different probabilities in the same context. One model might favour unexpected, while another gives more weight to surprising. The difference can be too small to notice in a single response, yet it influences which words and constructions appear across a larger collection of outputs. Taken together, those tendencies form a natural model fingerprint.

sentences.en: Different models assign different probabilities in the same context.
sentences.zh: 不同的模型在相同的上下文中分配不同的概率。

sentences.en: One model might favour unexpected, while another gives more weight to surprising.
sentences.zh: 一种模型可能偏爱意外，而另一种则更重视意外。

sentences.en: The difference can be too small to notice in a single response, yet it influences which words and constructions appear across a larger collection of outputs.
sentences.zh: 差异可能太小而无法在单个响应中注意到，但它会影响在更大的输出集合中出现的单词和结构。

sentences.en: Taken together, those tendencies form a natural model fingerprint.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，这些倾向形成了自然的模型指纹。

blocks.html_en: The fingerprint comes from the entire system that produces the text. Several parts of that system shape the observed pattern:

sentences.en: The fingerprint comes from the entire system that produces the text.
sentences.zh: 指纹来自生成文本的整个系统。

sentences.en: Several parts of that system shape the observed pattern:
sentences.zh: 该系统的几个部分塑造了观察到的模式：

blocks.html_en: • Training data and model architecture shape the underlying probability distribution.

sentences.en: Training data and model architecture shape the underlying probability distribution.
sentences.zh: 训练数据和模型架构塑造了潜在的概率分布。

blocks.html_en: • Post-training changes which kinds of responses the model favours.

sentences.en: Post-training changes which kinds of responses the model favours.
sentences.zh: 训练后会改变模型偏爱的响应类型。

blocks.html_en: • System prompts and product-level instructions influence the model before it generates a response.

sentences.en: System prompts and product-level instructions influence the model before it generates a response.
sentences.zh: 系统提示和产品级指令会在模型生成响应之前影响模型。

blocks.html_en: • Decoding and sampling settings, including temperature (a control that makes token choices more predictable at lower values and more varied at higher values), determine how the system selects from the available tokens.

sentences.en: Decoding and sampling settings, including temperature (a control that makes token choices more predictable at lower values and more varied at higher values), determine how the system selects from the available tokens.
sentences.zh: 解码和采样设置，包括温度（一种控制，使令牌选择在较低值时更可预测，在较高值时更加多样化），确定系统如何从可用令牌中进行选择。

blocks.html_en: Even when the underlying model remains fixed, changes to its system prompt or sampling settings can alter the pattern in its output. A fingerprint therefore characterizes the complete generation setup rather than the model alone. This means versions of the same model can leave different fingerprints. A provider can update training, adjust post-training, revise its system prompts, or change how the product samples tokens. An attribution method built around the old behaviour can lose accuracy after such a change. A fingerprint describes a particular generation process under particular conditions rather than a permanent identity attached to a brand name.

sentences.en: Even when the underlying model remains fixed, changes to its system prompt or sampling settings can alter the pattern in its output.
sentences.zh: 即使底层模型保持固定，对其系统提示或采样设置的更改也可能会改变其输出中的模式。

sentences.en: A fingerprint therefore characterizes the complete generation setup rather than the model alone.
sentences.zh: 因此，指纹表征了完整的生成设置，而不仅仅是模型。

sentences.en: This means versions of the same model can leave different fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 这意味着同一型号的不同版本可能会留下不同的指纹。

sentences.en: A provider can update training, adjust post-training, revise its system prompts, or change how the product samples tokens.
sentences.zh: 提供商可以更新培训、调整培训后、修改其系统提示或更改产品采样令牌的方式。

sentences.en: An attribution method built around the old behaviour can lose accuracy after such a change.
sentences.zh: 围绕旧行为构建的归因方法在发生此类更改后可能会失去准确性。

sentences.en: A fingerprint describes a particular generation process under particular conditions rather than a permanent identity attached to a brand name.
sentences.zh: 指纹描述了特定条件下的特定生成过程，而不是附加到品牌名称上的永久身份。

blocks.html_en: So model fingerprinting is essentially stylometry taken one step further. Human stylometry infers likely authorship from linguistic patterns that arise through a person's ordinary writing habits. The writer does not need to place a signature in the text or follow a secret procedure. The evidence comes from tendencies already present in the writing. Model fingerprinting applies the same broad idea to text generated from a model's ordinary probability distributions. It looks for patterns associated with a likely generation setup. The model does not need to cooperate with the detector, and the generation process does not need to encode a deliberate signal.

sentences.en: So model fingerprinting is essentially stylometry taken one step further.
sentences.zh: 因此，模型指纹识别本质上是更进一步的风格测量。

sentences.en: Human stylometry infers likely authorship from linguistic patterns that arise through a person's ordinary writing habits.
sentences.zh: 人类文体测量法根据一个人的日常写作习惯产生的语言模式推断出可能的作者身份。

sentences.en: The writer does not need to place a signature in the text or follow a secret procedure.
sentences.zh: 作者不需要在文本中签名或遵循秘密程序。

sentences.en: The evidence comes from tendencies already present in the writing.
sentences.zh: 证据来自于写作中已经存在的倾向。

sentences.en: Model fingerprinting applies the same broad idea to text generated from a model's ordinary probability distributions.
sentences.zh: 模型指纹识别将相同的广泛思想应用于从模型的普通概率分布生成的文本。

sentences.en: It looks for patterns associated with a likely generation setup.
sentences.zh: 它寻找与可能的生成设置相关的模式。

sentences.en: The model does not need to cooperate with the detector, and the generation process does not need to encode a deliberate signal.
sentences.zh: 该模型不需要与检测器配合，生成过程也不需要对有意的信号进行编码。

blocks.html_en: And finally, we have arrived at the final idea: what if we deliberately influence the model's choices to create a stronger, more detectable signal? That is the essence of text watermarking:

sentences.en: And finally, we have arrived at the final idea: what if we deliberately influence the model's choices to create a stronger, more detectable signal?
sentences.zh: 最后，我们得出了最终的想法：如果我们故意影响模型的选择以创建更强、更容易检测到的信号会怎么样？

sentences.en: That is the essence of text watermarking:
sentences.zh: 这就是文本水印的本质：

blocks.html_en: By guiding the model's token selection in a controlled way, we can embed a statistical pattern that a detector can later identify.

sentences.en: By guiding the model's token selection in a controlled way, we can embed a statistical pattern that a detector can later identify.
sentences.zh: 通过以受控方式指导模型的标记选择，我们可以嵌入检测器稍后可以识别的统计模式。

blocks.html_en: By guiding the model's token selection in a controlled way, we can embed a statistical pattern that a detector can later identify.

sentences.en: By guiding the model's token selection in a controlled way, we can embed a statistical pattern that a detector can later identify.
sentences.zh: 通过以受控方式指导模型的标记选择，我们可以嵌入检测器稍后可以识别的统计模式。

blocks.html_en: From a technical perspective, I'm finding the idea fascinating: there is nothing new about the underlying statistical principles, but the whole process of altering a model's output to leave a detectable signal in plain text is pure evil genius. Let's see how it works in practice.

sentences.en: From a technical perspective, I'm finding the idea fascinating: there is nothing new about the underlying statistical principles, but the whole process of altering a model's output to leave a detectable signal in plain text is pure evil genius.
sentences.zh: 从技术角度来看，我发现这个想法很有趣：基本的统计原理并没有什么新意，但改变模型输出以在纯文本中留下可检测信号的整个过程纯粹是邪恶的天才。

sentences.en: Let's see how it works in practice.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看它在实践中是如何运作的。

blocks.html_en: Tiny Differences Become Evidence

sentences.en: Tiny Differences Become Evidence
sentences.zh: 微小的差异成为证据

blocks.html_en: Creating a statistical pattern does not make every affected token identifiable. A model choosing however instead of but proves nothing because both people and models can choose either word regardless of whether a watermark is present. The useful evidence lies in the balance of choices across the text rather than in any particular word.

sentences.en: Creating a statistical pattern does not make every affected token identifiable.
sentences.zh: 创建统计模式并不能使每个受影响的令牌都可识别。

sentences.en: A model choosing however instead of but proves nothing because both people and models can choose either word regardless of whether a watermark is present.
sentences.zh: 模型选择“but”而不是“but”并不能证明什么，因为无论是否存在水印，人和模型都可以选择任何一个单词。

sentences.en: The useful evidence lies in the balance of choices across the text rather than in any particular word.
sentences.zh: 有用的证据在于文本中选择的平衡，而不是任何特定的单词。

blocks.html_en: Suppose a detectable pattern makes one group of otherwise reasonable tokens slightly more likely to be selected. A short sentence might contain only a few places where that preference can affect the output. Its final token sequence can easily match the pattern by chance, or miss the pattern even when the generation process applied it. A confident conclusion would demand more evidence than the sentence contains.

sentences.en: Suppose a detectable pattern makes one group of otherwise reasonable tokens slightly more likely to be selected.
sentences.zh: 假设一个可检测的模式使得一组原本合理的标记被选择的可能性稍高一些。

sentences.en: A short sentence might contain only a few places where that preference can affect the output.
sentences.zh: 一个短句子可能只包含该偏好可以影响输出的几个地方。

sentences.en: Its final token sequence can easily match the pattern by chance, or miss the pattern even when the generation process applied it.
sentences.zh: 它的最终标记序列很容易偶然匹配该模式，或者即使在生成过程应用它时也会错过该模式。

sentences.en: A confident conclusion would demand more evidence than the sentence contains.
sentences.zh: 一个可信的结论需要比句子包含的更多证据。

blocks.html_en: A 50,000-word document, on the other hand, presents a radically different measurement problem. It contains many opportunities for the generation process to express the same small preference. Some choices will lean away from the expected pattern, as random variation guarantees, while the aggregate can still show a persistent imbalance. The detector becomes less concerned with any single selection and more concerned with whether the observed total is plausible under ordinary generation.

sentences.en: A 50,000-word document, on the other hand, presents a radically different measurement problem.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，一份 50,000 字的文档则提出了一个完全不同的测量问题。

sentences.en: It contains many opportunities for the generation process to express the same small preference.
sentences.zh: 它包含了生成过程中表达相同小偏好的许多机会。

sentences.en: Some choices will lean away from the expected pattern, as random variation guarantees, while the aggregate can still show a persistent imbalance.
sentences.zh: 正如随机变化所保证的那样，某些选择将偏离预期模式，而总体仍可能表现出持续的不平衡。

sentences.en: The detector becomes less concerned with any single selection and more concerned with whether the observed total is plausible under ordinary generation.
sentences.zh: 检测器变得不太关心任何单个选择，而更关心观察到的总数在普通生成下是否合理。

blocks.html_en: The intuition resembles repeated measurement. One noisy observation leaves many explanations open, while a large collection can reveal a small effect that remains invisible at the individual level. Statistical tests turn that accumulated difference into a score by comparing the observed pattern with an expected baseline. The strength of the result depends on both the size of the measured effect and the amount of usable text.

sentences.en: The intuition resembles repeated measurement.
sentences.zh: 直觉类似于重复测量。

sentences.en: One noisy observation leaves many explanations open, while a large collection can reveal a small effect that remains invisible at the individual level.
sentences.zh: 一项嘈杂的观察留下了许多解释，而大量的收集可以揭示在个体层面上仍然看不见的微小影响。

sentences.en: Statistical tests turn that accumulated difference into a score by comparing the observed pattern with an expected baseline.
sentences.zh: 统计测试通过将观察到的模式与预期基线进行比较，将累积的差异转化为分数。

sentences.en: The strength of the result depends on both the size of the measured effect and the amount of usable text.
sentences.zh: 结果的强度取决于测量效果的大小和可用文本的数量。

blocks.html_en: Token choices are not independent observations. Each selected token becomes context for the next selection, so neighbouring choices influence one another. Topic and prompting change which vocabulary is available, while editing can remove or replace parts of the original pattern. Distribution shift creates another problem when the analysed text comes from different conditions than the text used to design or calibrate the detector.

sentences.en: Token choices are not independent observations.
sentences.zh: 代币选择不是独立的观察。

sentences.en: Each selected token becomes context for the next selection, so neighbouring choices influence one another.
sentences.zh: 每个选定的标记都会成为下一个选择的上下文，因此相邻的选择会相互影响。

sentences.en: Topic and prompting change which vocabulary is available, while editing can remove or replace parts of the original pattern.
sentences.zh: 主题和提示可以更改可用的词汇，而编辑可以删除或替换部分原始模式。

sentences.en: Distribution shift creates another problem when the analysed text comes from different conditions than the text used to design or calibrate the detector.
sentences.zh: 当分析的文本来自与用于设计或校准检测器的文本不同的条件时，分布偏移会产生另一个问题。

blocks.html_en: Engineering the Fingerprint

sentences.en: Engineering the Fingerprint
sentences.zh: 指纹工程

blocks.html_en: A watermarking system creates a stronger pattern by changing the probabilities the model already calculated. Consider a moment when the model has several reasonable ways to describe a server under load. Its original distribution could look like this:

sentences.en: A watermarking system creates a stronger pattern by changing the probabilities the model already calculated.
sentences.zh: 水印系统通过改变模型已经计算的概率来创建更强的模式。

sentences.en: Consider a moment when the model has several reasonable ways to describe a server under load.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下模型有几种合理的方法来描述负载下的服务器的情况。

sentences.en: Its original distribution could look like this:
sentences.zh: 它的原始分布可能如下所示：

blocks.html_en: The watermarking rule marks some of the available tokens as preferred for this particular position. It then moves a small amount of probability towards those tokens before the sampling process makes its choice:

sentences.en: The watermarking rule marks some of the available tokens as preferred for this particular position.
sentences.zh: 水印规则将一些可用令牌标记为该特定位置的首选。

sentences.en: It then moves a small amount of probability towards those tokens before the sampling process makes its choice:
sentences.zh: 然后，在采样过程做出选择之前，它会向这些标记移动少量概率：

blocks.html_en: The model remains free to select any of the candidates. Preferred tokens simply become a little more likely, allowing fluency and variation to remain. A reader has no reason to find overloaded or saturated suspicious because both fit the context perfectly well.

sentences.en: The model remains free to select any of the candidates.
sentences.zh: 该模型仍然可以自由选择任何候选人。

sentences.en: Preferred tokens simply become a little more likely, allowing fluency and variation to remain.
sentences.zh: 首选标记变得更有可能，从而保持流畅性和变化。

sentences.en: A reader has no reason to find overloaded or saturated suspicious because both fit the context perfectly well.
sentences.zh: 读者没有理由发现过多或饱和的可疑之处，因为两者都非常适合上下文。

blocks.html_en: The shift becomes visible only in aggregate, as the previous section explained. Preferred choices appear more often than the original distribution predicts, and a detector measures that excess. A statistical text watermark is an engineered fingerprint: the generation process deliberately strengthens a pattern that ordinary text would exhibit only by chance.

sentences.en: The shift becomes visible only in aggregate, as the previous section explained.
sentences.zh: 正如上一节所解释的，这种转变只有在总体上才可见。

sentences.en: Preferred choices appear more often than the original distribution predicts, and a detector measures that excess.
sentences.zh: 首选选择出现的频率比原始分布预测的要高，检测器会测量超出的部分。

sentences.en: A statistical text watermark is an engineered fingerprint: the generation process deliberately strengthens a pattern that ordinary text would exhibit only by chance.
sentences.zh: 统计文本水印是一种工程指纹：生成过程故意强化了普通文本仅偶然出现的模式。

blocks.html_en: Where the Secret Pattern Comes From

sentences.en: Where the Secret Pattern Comes From
sentences.zh: 秘密图案从何而来

blocks.html_en: A fixed list of preferred words would be easy to discover and remove. Practical proposals instead derive the preference from a secret key and the local context. A deterministic calculation uses the key to process the preceding tokens, with some designs also incorporating the current position, and divides suitable next tokens into preferred and ordinary sets.

sentences.en: A fixed list of preferred words would be easy to discover and remove.
sentences.zh: 固定的首选单词列表很容易发现和删除。

sentences.en: Practical proposals instead derive the preference from a secret key and the local context.
sentences.zh: 相反，实际的建议是从密钥和本地上下文中得出偏好。

sentences.en: A deterministic calculation uses the key to process the preceding tokens, with some designs also incorporating the current position, and divides suitable next tokens into preferred and ordinary sets.
sentences.zh: 确定性计算使用密钥来处理前面的标记，某些设计还结合当前位置，并将合适的下一个标记划分为首选和普通集合。

blocks.html_en: The calculation is pseudorandom, which means its results look random to someone without the key while remaining exactly reproducible for someone who has it. The generator and detector can therefore agree on which tokens were preferred at every position without storing a copy of each decision. An observer who sees only the finished text cannot reconstruct the pattern from a simple vocabulary list.

sentences.en: The calculation is pseudorandom, which means its results look random to someone without the key while remaining exactly reproducible for someone who has it.
sentences.zh: 该计算是伪随机的，这意味着其结果对于没有密钥的人来说看起来是随机的，而对于拥有密钥的人来说仍然可以完全重现。

sentences.en: The generator and detector can therefore agree on which tokens were preferred at every position without storing a copy of each decision.
sentences.zh: 因此，生成器和检测器可以就每个位置首选哪些令牌达成一致，而无需存储每个决策的副本。

sentences.en: An observer who sees only the finished text cannot reconstruct the pattern from a simple vocabulary list.
sentences.zh: 只看到完成文本的观察者无法从简单的词汇列表中重建模式。

blocks.html_en: The same word can play a different role each time it appears. However might belong to the preferred set after one sequence of tokens and to the ordinary set after another. Descriptions claiming that a model will use a collection of special watermark words miss this context dependence. The signal comes from the relationship between each token and the context in which the model selected it.

sentences.en: The same word can play a different role each time it appears.
sentences.zh: 同一个词每次出现都可以发挥不同的作用。

sentences.en: However might belong to the preferred set after one sequence of tokens and to the ordinary set after another.
sentences.zh: 然而，在一个令牌序列之后可能属于首选集合，而在另一个令牌序列之后可能属于普通集合。

sentences.en: Descriptions claiming that a model will use a collection of special watermark words miss this context dependence.
sentences.zh: 声称模型将使用特殊水印单词集合的描述忽略了这种上下文依赖性。

sentences.en: The signal comes from the relationship between each token and the context in which the model selected it.
sentences.zh: 该信号来自每个标记与模型选择它的上下文之间的关系。

blocks.html_en: Keeping the key private also protects the scheme. Someone who learns the selection rule can deliberately avoid preferred tokens to weaken the signal or favour them to imitate it. The security of the mechanism therefore depends partly on controlling access to the information needed to reconstruct the pattern.

sentences.en: Keeping the key private also protects the scheme.
sentences.zh: 将密钥保密也可以保护该方案。

sentences.en: Someone who learns the selection rule can deliberately avoid preferred tokens to weaken the signal or favour them to imitate it.
sentences.zh: 学习选择规则的人可以故意避免首选标记以削弱信号或有利于他们模仿它。

sentences.en: The security of the mechanism therefore depends partly on controlling access to the information needed to reconstruct the pattern.
sentences.zh: 因此，该机制的安全性部分取决于对重建模式所需信息的访问控制。

blocks.html_en: This is why the idea has a very high ceiling: the patterns can be arbitrarily complex, and a detector that knows the key can reconstruct the same sets and test for the expected imbalance. Over time, we can expect to see more sophisticated watermarking schemes that are harder to remove and easier to detect, while still leaving the text fluent and natural. Applying the same increasingly complex, evolved patterns to fingerprinting and stylometry has huge potential too.

sentences.en: This is why the idea has a very high ceiling: the patterns can be arbitrarily complex, and a detector that knows the key can reconstruct the same sets and test for the expected imbalance.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这个想法具有非常高的上限：模式可以任意复杂，并且知道密钥的检测器可以重建相同的集合并测试预期的不平衡。

sentences.en: Over time, we can expect to see more sophisticated watermarking schemes that are harder to remove and easier to detect, while still leaving the text fluent and natural.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们预计会看到更复杂的水印方案，这些方案更难去除、更容易检测，同时仍然保持文本流畅和自然。

sentences.en: Applying the same increasingly complex, evolved patterns to fingerprinting and stylometry has huge potential too.
sentences.zh: 将同样日益复杂、进化的模式应用于指纹识别和风格测量也具有巨大的潜力。

blocks.html_en: Detecting and Damaging the Signal

sentences.en: Detecting and Damaging the Signal
sentences.zh: 检测和破坏信号

blocks.html_en: Detection repeats the keyed calculation against the finished text. Given the text and the information defining the watermark, the detector works through four operations:

sentences.en: Detection repeats the keyed calculation against the finished text.
sentences.zh: 检测针对完成的文本重复键控计算。

sentences.en: Given the text and the information defining the watermark, the detector works through four operations:
sentences.zh: 给定文本和定义水印的信息，检测器通过四个操作进行工作：

blocks.html_en: • Reconstruct the preferred token set at each usable position.

sentences.en: Reconstruct the preferred token set at each usable position.
sentences.zh: 在每个可用位置重建首选令牌集。

blocks.html_en: • Record how often the text selected a preferred token.

sentences.en: Record how often the text selected a preferred token.
sentences.zh: 记录文本选择首选标记的频率。

blocks.html_en: • Compare that count with the result expected from ordinary text.

sentences.en: Compare that count with the result expected from ordinary text.
sentences.zh: 将该计数与普通文本的预期结果进行比较。

blocks.html_en: • Calculate how surprising the observed excess would be by chance.

sentences.en: Calculate how surprising the observed excess would be by chance.
sentences.zh: 计算一下观察到的过量现象是多么令人惊讶。

blocks.html_en: The output is a statistical score rather than a hidden field reading AI_GENERATED=true. A detection service chooses a threshold above which it reports the watermark as present. Raising that threshold reduces false positives but misses more genuinely watermarked text, while lowering it catches weaker signals at the cost of more false alarms.

sentences.en: The output is a statistical score rather than a hidden field reading AI_GENERATED=true.
sentences.zh: 输出是统计分数，而不是读取 AI_GENERATED=true 的隐藏字段。

sentences.en: A detection service chooses a threshold above which it reports the watermark as present.
sentences.zh: 检测服务选择一个阈值，高于该阈值则报告水印存在。

sentences.en: Raising that threshold reduces false positives but misses more genuinely watermarked text, while lowering it catches weaker signals at the cost of more false alarms.
sentences.zh: 提高该阈值可以减少误报，但会错过更多真正的带水印的文本，而降低该阈值则会捕获较弱的信号，但会产生更多的误报。

blocks.html_en: Obviously, copypaste preserves the signal because it preserves the selected text. Editing behaves differently because every replacement removes one observation and introduces another. The expected signal weakens as more of the original wording is replaced:

sentences.en: Obviously, copypaste preserves the signal because it preserves the selected text.
sentences.zh: 显然，复制粘贴会保留信号，因为它保留了所选文本。

sentences.en: Editing behaves differently because every replacement removes one observation and introduces another.
sentences.zh: 编辑的行为有所不同，因为每次替换都会删除一个观察结果并引入另一个观察结果。

sentences.en: The expected signal weakens as more of the original wording is replaced:
sentences.zh: 随着更多原始措辞被替换，预期信号减弱：

blocks.html_en: Ordinary corrections often leave enough original choices for detection, especially in a long passage. Extensive rewriting replaces a larger share of the evidence, and a fresh paraphrase can produce a new token sequence with little connection to the original pattern. A watermark's robustness is its ability to remain detectable after the text has been edited. It can be measured by how the detector's confidence falls as more of the original choices are replaced.

sentences.en: Ordinary corrections often leave enough original choices for detection, especially in a long passage.

blocks.html_en: Conclusion

sentences.en: Conclusion

blocks.html_en: Plain text has no separate layer in which a durable marker can hide, yet the choices that compose the text provide another channel. A watermarking system uses a secret rule to favour certain acceptable tokens in particular contexts. Those small interventions accumulate into a pattern that copying preserves, editing weakens, and a detector can measure against chance. The mechanism gives a provenance system a measurable signal. A complete history of the text remains outside its reach. Detection cannot reveal who requested the output or who later revised it, and the final document can contain material assembled through several different processes. The statistical result describes the text presented to the detector under the assumptions built into that detector.
